title.zh: 自行车维修工坊零件柜台助理

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Match approved part numbers to stock and catalogue entries and reconcile incoming deliveries.
requirements.zh: 将获批零件编号与库存及目录条目匹配，并核对到货。

requirements.en: Maintain labeled reservations and order status, and notify customers about collections.
requirements.zh: 维护有标签的预留件及订单状态，并通知客户取件。

requirements.en: Keep clear handovers for shortages, uncollected parts and unresolved supplier queries.
requirements.zh: 为短缺、未取零件及未解决供应商咨询保留清晰交接记录。
